FIELDS.NAME: ElectroFix Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At ElectroFix Solutions, we specialize in the retail of electronic devices and provide comprehensive repair services for a variety of products, including smartphones, laptops, and home electronics. Our operations are centered around our physical storefront located at 1234 Tech Avenue in Springfield, which has been serving the community for over three years. We prioritize hands-on customer service, ensuring that each client receives personalized attention whether they are purchasing new technology or seeking repairs. Our experienced technicians are well-trained and certified, maintaining a high standard of quality in all repair operations. We have implemented an efficient inventory management system to track our products and manage repairs effectively, while also complying with all local zoning, health, and safety regulations. To further enhance our security, we have installed a central alarm system that operates 24/7, protecting our valuable inventory and providing peace of mind for our customers. We do not engage in equipment rentals, ensuring that we maintain a focused retail environment. Overall, our commitment to quality, safety, and customer satisfaction defines our operations at ElectroFix Solutions.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/12/2023, a break-in occurred at our store, resulting in the theft of electronic devices valued at $700. The incident was reported to the police, and we have since enhanced our security measures. The claim status is currently open as we are awaiting the insurance investigation outcome. Additionally, on 05/24/2022, a customer injured themselves while visiting our store, resulting in a medical expense claim totaling $300, which has been settled.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 7 PM; Saturday: 10 AM - 5 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B Safe, UL listed, Grade 1.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system installed with 24/7 monitoring and security patrols during non-operating hours.
